name: sub-meter
description: Your subscription usage at the bottom right of Claude Code: the 5-hour and weekly windows, as a bar that takes turns. Click it to switch, hover it for a usage graph. Fork of midudev/better-claude.

author.name: Matthew Winfield (fork of Miguel Ángel Durán (midudev))

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per window
rotateSeconds.description: How long the meter shows each window (5-hour, weekly) before it switches to the other. Paused while the pointer is on the meter or its graph; a click switches at once and starts it over.

hideCycleHint.title: Hide the mode cycle hint
hideCycleHint.description: Drop "(shift+tab to cycle)" after the permission mode, to leave room for the meter.
